description: This file contains shell script code that sets up tests for a Git hook and performs repository push operations, including verifying output and references.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful completion.

methods.name: test_tool proc-receive
methods.description: Invokes the external 'test-tool' program to test the 'proc-receive' hook.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes output to produce a stable, user-friendly format.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output to expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares current references to expected references.
